info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cheque Lock Box Management API
info.description: The Cheque Lock Box Management API facilitates the updating of cheque lock box configurations within the banking trade services. This endpoint allows authorized users to modify parameters related to cheque processing and management, ensuring operational efficiency. Common consumers of this API include bank personnel and financial service providers who require real-time updates to cheque handling processes. Utilize this API to streamline cheque-related workflows and enhance transactional systems.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific cheque lock box identified by its unique resource ID. You can modify various attributes related to the cheque lock box by providing the necessary data in the request body.
